title: Provision clear state cannot survive reboot without restoring cleared epoch or losing rollback floor
description: Timing security review: ProvisionVerifier.clear retains the rollback record only in memory and persists only an opaque reason. The constructor accepts no cleared persistent state: rebooting with the retained ProvisionRollbackState automatically restores the cleared epoch as active, while rebooting without it loses the minimum version floor or requires a new virgin marker. Reinstalling the same record after clear also skips persist_rollback because the in-memory candidate equals rollback, so live accepted state may not be durable. Define a canonical authenticated persisted cleared state that retains record-version and digest floor while marking the epoch inactive; restore it fail-closed, and repersist any reactivation before use. Test clear-reboot, same-record reinstall-reboot, higher install, rollback, corruption, and persistence faults.
